item: Project skeleton and CI; dependencies: none; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-01-project-skeleton-and-ci
acceptance_criteria: Given a project change is pushed, when CI runs, then the project builds and automated tests and coverage checks report their results.

item: Account login; dependencies: B-01; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-02-account-login
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing account with valid credentials, when the user signs in, then the system authenticates the account and denies access for invalid credentials.

item: Role authorization; dependencies: B-02; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-03-role-authorization
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated account with an assigned role, when it requests an authorized action, then access is granted and unauthorized actions are denied.

item: Create and save quiz; dependencies: B-02; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-04-create-and-save-quiz
acceptance_criteria: Given an authenticated instructor, when they enter quiz details and save, then the quiz is persisted and appears in their quiz list.

item: Add multiple-choice question; dependencies: B-04; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-05-add-multiple-choice-question
acceptance_criteria: Given an instructor is editing a quiz, when they enter a question with answer options and select the correct answer, then the question and answer are saved to that quiz.

item: Edit or remove question; dependencies: B-05; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-06-edit-or-remove-question
acceptance_criteria: Given a saved quiz question, when its owner edits or removes it and saves, then the question list reflects the change.

item: Set question timer; dependencies: B-05; sketch: scrum-setup.md#b-07-set-question-timer
acceptance_criteria: Given an instructor is editing a quiz question, when they enter a valid timer value and save, then that value is stored with the question.
